target: Compare two plausible methods for robustness using a perturbation stress battery. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

competency.title: Compare robustness — few shot
competency.outcome: Compare two plausible methods for robustness using a perturbation stress battery. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
competency.practice_task: Produce a paired comparison and tradeoff table grounded in a perturbation stress battery.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a paired comparison and tradeoff table
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report worst-group score and failure rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: reporting only aggregate mean.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of robustness.
Practice: same inputs and budgets yield a justified choice.
Measurement: report worst-group score and failure rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reporting only aggregate mean; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
